name: Anaglyph
summary: Left and right eye views encoded as different colour channels in a single standard frame. Requires coloured glasses to separate the views. Works on any display with no special hardware. Quality varies significantly by variant — red/cyan is most common but amber/blue preserves the most colour.

variants.name: Red / Cyan
variants.description: Most widely used anaglyph format. Left eye through red filter, right eye through cyan. Significant colour distortion — reds and cyans are lost.

variants.name: Red / Blue
variants.description: Older variant. Lower quality than red/cyan. Rarely used in modern implementations.

variants.name: Green / Magenta
variants.description: Better colour balance than red/cyan in some scenes. Less common.

variants.name: Amber / Blue (ColorCode 3D)
variants.description: Preserves the most colour information of any anaglyph variant. Requires specific amber/blue glasses. Best anaglyph experience when glasses are available.
